notes: 1) Timing measurements referenced to low=0.8V and high=2.0V unless otherwise noted.
2) Specs apply only if MC68881 has completed internal operations initiated by termination of previous bus cycle when DS was negated.
3) Synchronous read cycles occur only when the save or response CIR locations are read.
4) Applies to systems with back-to-back accesses (read-write or write-write) of operand CIR. With MC68020/68030 as coprocessor, can occur when addressing mode is immediate.
5) If SIZE pin is not strapped to VCC or GND, it must have same setup times as addresses.
6) If SIZE pin is not strapped to VCC or GND, it must have same hold times as addresses.
7) This number is reduced to 5 ns if DSACK0 and DSACK1 have equal loads.
8) START is not external; logical condition indicating start of access. START = CS + AS + (R/W · DS).
9) If subsequent access is not FPcr access, CS must be negated before assertion of AS and/or DS on the non-FPcr access; these replace old specs 8 and 8A.
